title: MkDocs Material front matter v9.7
description: Front matter read by MkDocs 1.6 and Material for MkDocs 9.7 — the two keys MkDocs itself defines (`title`, `template`), the six Material's own templates read, the three its bundled plugins read, and the eight the blog plugin reads on a post. Nothing is required: MkDocs takes a page title from the `nav`, the first H1 or the file name in turn, so a page with no front matter at all builds and renders. That makes it a pure shape check, and the shapes worth checking are the ones the build accepts and then acts on wrongly — a `hide` entry no template tests for, a `tags` string the search plugin skips, a `date` mapping with no `created`. Pinned to Material 9.7 because 9.7.0 is the last feature release of the line. See https://www.mkdocs.org/user-guide/writing-your-docs/#meta-data and https://squidfunk.github.io/mkdocs-material/reference/

title.description: Overrides the page title. MkDocs checks the `nav` entry, then this, then the first H1, then the file name, and stops at the first that answers — so nothing breaks without it.

template.description: The theme template rendering this page, instead of `main.html`. Resolved against the theme's template directory, so a name the theme does not carry fails the build.

description.description: Becomes the page's `<meta name="description">`, and the description on its social card.

author.description: Becomes the page's `<meta name="author">`. One name, not a list — Material renders the value straight into the attribute. The blog plugin's `authors` is a different key.

icon.description: An icon shortcode, resolved as `.icons/<value>.svg` — so `material/cached`, not `material/cached.svg`. Shown beside the page in the navigation.

status.description: A status marker shown in the navigation. `new` and `deprecated` ship with the theme; any other value has to be declared in `theme.extra.status`, so the set is site-configured and not enumerated here.

subtitle.description: Rendered under the page's navigation entry. Added in Material 9.6.

hide.description: Page elements to hide. Material tests membership of this list in its templates and reports nothing for an entry it does not know, so a value outside these six hides nothing and says nothing.

tags.description: Tags for this page, read by the tags plugin and added to the search index. A list, never a bare string: the search plugin skips a `tags` that is not a list without a word.

exclude.description: Keeps the page out of the search index entirely.

boost.description: Multiplies the page's search ranking. Copied into the index as written, so a quoted number arrives as a string and ranks nothing.

social.description: Per-page overrides of the social cards plugin's site-level settings.

cards.description: `false` skips card generation for this page.

cards_layout.description: The layout to render this page's card with, resolved under `cards_layout_dir`.

cards_layout_options.description: Layout options merged over the site-level ones — `title`, `description`, `background_color`, `background_image`, `color`, `font_family`. Left unconstrained beyond its type, because the keys a layout reads are the layout's own.

date.description: A blog post's date: the date itself, or a mapping carrying `created` plus any other date you want the templates to have. The blog plugin errors on a post with no `date` at all, and on a mapping with no `created`. Typed but not format-checked: MkDocs parses front matter with PyYAML, which resolves several timestamp spellings, so pinning one format here would fail input the plugin accepts.

authors.description: A blog post's authors, as identifiers defined in `.authors.yml`. Duplicates are dropped silently, so they are not an error here.

categories.description: A blog post's categories. Deduplicated the same way as `authors`.

draft.description: Holds a post back from the built site. A quoted `"false"` is a string, which the post configuration refuses outright.

pin.description: Pins a post to the top of the blog views. Defaults to false.

readtime.description: Overrides the computed reading time, in minutes.

slug.description: Overrides the URL segment a post is built at, otherwise derived from its title.

links.description: Links shown in a post's sidebar, written in the same shape as `nav`: a path, or a mapping of label to path.
